definition: Happy-puppet syndrome is an older name for Angelman syndrome, a genetic condition marked by intellectual disability, movement and motor problems, and multiple physical abnormalities. Common features include frequent laughter episodes that are easily triggered, jerky puppet-like movements, poor muscle tone, ataxia, tongue protrusion, and developmental slowing.
